revenueModel.text: Franchisees pay initial and continuing monthly fees based on a percentage of their restaurants' sales for the right to operate our Concepts.
revenueModel.evidence: Franchisees also pay monthly continuing fees based on a percentage of their restaurants' sales (typically between 4% to 6%) and are required to spend a certain amount to advertise and promote the brand.
